sentences.text:
Superintendent of Police, Kota City has marked presence in the Court and has submitted that qua the directions of the Ld. Trial Court, Kota vide dated 11.03.2024, the present FIR no.
214/2024 dated 02.07.2024 was registered at Police Station Railway Colony, District Kota City by Petitioner no- 1 for offences under section 420, 467, 468 of I.P.C., wherein, investigation is ongoing.

entities.text: Police Station Railway Colony, District Kota City
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: It is further submitted that as per the revenue records, the said disputed property is reflected in the name of U.I.T./Civil Authority.
The said contentions are endorsed by the Secretary of U.I.T., (present via VC).

Howsoever, Superintendent of Police has assured the Court that investigation will be carried out expeditiously under her supervision by appropriate Investigating Officer in a fair, impartial and unbiased manner.

[2024:RJ-JP:42802] (4 of 4) [CRLMP-6476/2024] Learned counsel for the Petitioner no. 1- Vinod Bairwa has submitted that revenue records reflect that the disputed property is under the name of ancestors of the petitioner.
Additionally, learned counsel representing Petitioner no. 2- Sundeep has submitted that they are having possession of the disputed land from a long period.
Heard.

Considering that the investigation qua the instant dispute is ongoing and there are certain dubious of facts which can be made unambiguous only after thorough investigation, this Court is not inclined to interfere in the instant matter.

However, it is expected that the said investigation shall be culminated within an upper limit of eight weeks from the date of passing of this order, in an unbiased manner, under the supervision of the Superintendent of Police, Kota.
Withal, the petitioners are at a liberty to avail the alternate efficacious remedy available, strictly in accordance with law, if aggrieved of the result of the said investigation.
Accordingly, present petitions are disposed of, with the aforementioned directions and liberty being granted.
Pending applications, if any, shall stand disposed of.

(SAMEER JAIN),J Pooja /12-13 Powered by TCPDF (www.tcpdf.org)
